card.line: Italy is the land of the Roman Empire, the peninsula between the Alps and the Straits of Messina, where Paul was sent and where believers sent greetings.

moments.title: Aquila and Priscilla leave Italy
moments.text: In Corinth, Paul met Aquila and Priscilla, who had recently come from Italy. Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome, so they had to go.

moments.title: Paul sails for Italy
moments.text: Paul and other prisoners were handed over to a centurion named Julius. They boarded a ship as it was decided that they would sail for Italy.

moments.title: A ship bound for Italy
moments.text: At Myra, the centurion found an Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy and put Paul and the others on board.

moments.title: Greetings from Italy
moments.text: At the end of Hebrews, the writer passes on greetings. Those from Italy send their greetings to the saints and leaders.
